title: Elderline MP 14567
department: Social Justice & Disabled Welfare Department, MP
eligibility: Senior Citizens (60+ years) living in Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Information on old age homes, pension schemes, and healthcare
Field intervention for destitute or abused senior citizens
application_process: Step 1: Call 14567 (8 AM to 8 PM daily)
Step 2: Request scheme info, legal support, or field rescue intervention
important_sections_or_clauses: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007
